## What happens next

The website workflow checks that this issue belongs to `xm5o`, downloads the attached JPEG, validates it, replaces `assets/pfp.jpg`, commits the change, and closes this issue automatically.

Do not rename the issue title prefix. The workflow requires `[profile-update]`.
